readability.evidence: PasswordResetLinkController.php:147-153, NewPasswordController.php:79-88 and VerifyEmailController.php:48-50 have small focused methods with clear names and PHPDoc; routes/web.php:742-756 is declarative; no dead code or debug output

review.summary: Delivers the pt-BR PegaFila account e-mails, password-reset flow and verification link with correct routes, validation, throttling and translations. Conventions, security, tests, simplicity and scope all hold with no blocking issues, so the change is approvable as is.
